Kirk toured with Whitney Houston for more than 7 years and it?s his sax heard on the mega-hit, "I Will Always Love You", the best-selling single by a female artist in music history! Kirk soon followed that career high point with his phenomenal hit album on Warner Bros. Records, 'For You', perhaps the most successful of over 25 solo recordings to date. Other albums include his eclectic & much lauded, 'Gospel According to Jazz' series, (Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4) ? Chapter 2 & 4 both received GRAMMY® Award Nominations. events.name: Amina Figarova Sextet with Matsiko World Orphan Choir
events.info: Amina Figarova Sextet with Matsiko World Orphan ChoirHailing from Azerbaijan, then New Orleans by way of New York, Amina Figarova is an internationally influenced---and recognized---composer, pianist, and bandleader. Her roles come to the forefront with her sextet band and with a remarkable chemistry that brings her detailed arrangements to life. Every member of the group stands out, but their dedication to Figarova's eclectic and powerful compositions gives the group its depth of feeling. In 2018, Amina composed a suite for a South African children's choir and her sextet, which was performed at the , "rdquo" -> Joy of Jazz" Festival in Johannesburg, South Africa with a student choir from Soweto. Her aspiration was to record this masterpiece with the choir, but due to COVID-19 travel restrictions, it was impossible. However, fate intervened when Amina and Bart found themselves on the same flight from Europe to NYC with the Matsiko World Orphan Choir from Liberia. After conversing with the choir director, they decided to perform and record music together that was originally intended for South Africa. The choir consists of 24 orphaned and at-risk children from Liberia in West Africa. They have performed at jazz festivals and venues with the Amina Figarova Sextet, and churches across the USA in efforts to gain educational sponsors for their siblings, friends and families. events.name: JaeloX w/ High Heal Doula & Pro$per Jone$
events.info: Born and raised in New Orleans, Louisiana, JaeloX is a hip-hop artist whose music is deeply rooted in culture, consciousness, and storytelling. Coming from a family whose ties to the city stretch back generations, she carries the spirit, resilience, and creativity of New Orleans in both her artistry and perspective.Music was woven into the fabric of her upbringing. From childhood, the soundtrack of her life was shaped by the sounds that filled her home. Whether her mother was cooking, cleaning, or simply creating a moment to enjoy. Those experiences planted the seeds for a lifelong passion that would eventually become her purpose. Known for her sharp lyricism, thought-provoking subject matter, and commanding delivery, JaeloX uses music as a platform to challenge perspectives, spark conversation, and inspire growth. Drawing comparisons to conscious artists such as J. Cole while embodying the wordplay and Southern influence synonymous with Lil Wayne, she has developed a voice that is uniquely her own. Through introspective euphonies, social commentary, and authentic self-expression, JaeloX represents a new generation of artists who balance entertainment with substance. Her music speaks to those seeking truth, empowerment, and connection, proving that hip-hop can be both intellectually engaging and culturally impactful. Today, JaeloX continues to build her legacy from the city that raised her, creating music that honors her roots while pushing the culture forward. Join us for JaeloX's Halloween Bash featuring JaeloX, High Heal Doula and Pro$per Jone$! Get your tickets now!

events.name: Nickel-A-Dance: A Tribute to Jelly Roll Morton with Steve Pistorius and the Southern Syncopators
events.info: Nickel-A-Dance: A Tribute to Jelly Roll MortonNickel-A-Dance is a free, family-friendly jazz concert series in New Orleans, celebrating the city's rich musical heritage. Founded in 1994, it features top local jazz musicians performing classic jazz, blues, and swing. Originally held at Café Brasil on Frenchmen Street, the series now takes place at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro on Sundays from 3:00--6:00 PM. The event is open to all ages and aims to make live jazz accessible to everyone. Celebrate the music and legacy of one of New Orleans' most influential musical pioneers with Steve Pistorius and the Southern Syncopators in a special tribute to Jelly Roll Morton. Widely recognized as one of the key architects of early jazz, Jelly Roll Morton was a groundbreaking pianist, composer, arranger, and bandleader whose music helped define the sound of New Orleans jazz in the early 20th century. His compositions---including classics such as , "rdquo" -> King Porter Stomp," , "rdquo" -> Black Bottom Stomp," and , "rdquo" -> Jelly Roll Blues"---remain an essential part of the jazz tradition. Led by acclaimed pianist and New Orleans traditional jazz authority Steve Pistorius, the Southern Syncopators bring Morton's spirited compositions and distinctive musical language back to life. Expect an evening filled with hot jazz, swinging rhythms, intricate arrangements, and the unmistakable spirit of New Orleans. Join us at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro for a musical celebration of Jelly Roll Morton, presented by musicians deeply connected to the living tradition he helped establish. This is a free progam with no ticketing. Just come ready to dance. For more info on Nickel-A-Dance, visit: https://www.nojc.org/nickel-a-dance Shows from 3-6pm Doors at 2:30pm

events.info: Charmaine Neville BandCharmaine Neville, daughter of legendary saxophonist Charles Neville of the Neville Brothers, carries the torch of a rich New Orleans musical legacy. While she is rooted in the city's vibrant traditions, Charmaine brings her own unique voice to the stage, blending R&B, Jazz, and world rhythms into a sound that's all her own. Her performances are a reflection of the city's spirit---bold, diverse, and deeply soulful. Renowned for her high-energy live shows, Charmaine and her band captivate audiences with an infectious sense of joy and a strong emphasis on audience participation. Whether delivering soulful ballads or rhythm-driven grooves, she creates an unforgettable experience, inviting listeners to feel the music and become part of the celebration. Charmaine Neville's sound is a true reflection of the Crescent City: timeless, exciting, and impossible to resist.
